title: Storytime at Heald Green Library
venue: Heald Green Library, Finney Lane, SK8 3JB
description: A free weekly pre-school story and rhyme session at Heald Green Library.

title: Cheadle CoderDojo 60
venue: Moseley Hall, The Upper Room, 11 Wilmslow Road, Cheadle SK8 1DW
description: A free under-18 coding session for beginners and young people who already code. Bring a laptop or MacBook if possible because spare computers are limited.

title: Visit My Mosque at Cheadle Masjid
venue: Cheadle Masjid, 377 Wilmslow Road, Heald Green
description: A free open day from 11am to 3pm, with RSVP booking available. A useful chance to visit a familiar local building that many non-Muslim residents may not normally see inside.

title: Saturday Snack Down: Jungle Snack Down
venue: Stall 3 Market Hall, Market Place, SK1 1EW
description: A family-friendly monthly food event at Stockport Market with a jungle-themed edition.

title: Manchester Mid-Autumn Festival
description: Two free days of food, performances, workshops and family activities. The main Garden Event is listed from 12pm to 8pm on both days; the organiser says no booking is required for the main Garden Experience or Party.

title: Avro Heritage Museum free Heritage Open Day
description: Free opening from 10am to 4pm for Heritage Open Days. No advance booking is required. Displays cover Avro history and aircraft including Lancaster, Vulcan, VC10 and Nimrod cockpit experiences.

title: These Shining Lives at Players Theatre
venue: Players Theatre, Anfield Road, Cheadle Hulme SK8 5EX
description: Players Theatre stages These Shining Lives across six evenings. The play is based on the true story of four women at the Radium Dial Company in 1920s Illinois.

title: My John Lewis Beauty Takeover
venue: John Lewis Cheadle, first-floor Beauty Hall
description: A 4.30pm–8pm My John Lewis event. The £15 ticket is redeemable against Beauty purchases on the day and includes a drink, goody bag, prize draw, masterclasses and selected mini treatments.

title: Foodie Friday
description: Street food, craft ales and live music at Stockport Market.

title: Lifesavers basic life-support course
description: Free CPR, recovery-position and choking-response training for ages 10+. The organiser currently shows the course as full, so check for cancellations or reopened places rather than assuming spaces remain.
